message: Thanks, that sets the scene. How big was the checkout flow you were moving: how many orders a day went through it?

slot_updates.text: I was the tech lead for the checkout team.
quotes: I was the tech lead on checkout

slot_updates.text: The team was moving checkout to a new payments provider, and the rollout was already two weeks late with Black Friday a month away.
